boost.title: Boost — optimization
boost.option.section_culling.tip: Skip entities in occluded world sections (uses the game's visibility graph). Turns itself off under Sodium.
boost.option.item.tip: Dropped items beyond this distance are not drawn.
boost.option.projectile.tip: Arrows, tridents, snowballs and so on.
boost.option.mob.tip: Draw distance for mobs. Bosses and players are always drawn.
boost.option.detail.tip: Beyond this, armor, held items and other layers are skipped for mobs (twice as far for players).
boost.option.name_tag.tip: Name tag distance for mobs and items (players unaffected).
boost.option.block_entity.tip: Signs, chests, heads, banners and modded blocks beyond this are not drawn. Per type in boost.json.
boost.option.sign_text.tip: Signs beyond this are drawn without text.
boost.option.frame_content.tip: Beyond this, items and maps inside frames are not drawn.
boost.option.particle_culling.tip: Skip particles outside the view and too far away.
boost.option.particle.tip: Particles beyond this are not drawn.
boost.option.block_entity_tick.tip: Beyond this, client-side block entity animations are not updated.
boost.option.entity_tick.tip: Beyond this, items, orbs and armor stands tick 4 times less often.
boost.option.debug_line.tip: Show culling stats in the F3 screen.
boost.option.occlusion_culling.tip: Rays from the camera on a separate thread: entities and block entities fully hidden behind opaque blocks are not drawn.
boost.option.target_fps.tip: Target FPS: below it, entity, block entity and particle distances shrink smoothly (down to half) and recover once FPS is back.
